sentence: Even though I had admired them hundreds of times on my computer screen, nothing could have prepared me for the wonder I felt when I finally laid eyes on the real thing.
translation: 尽管我曾在电脑屏幕上欣赏过它们数百次，但当我终于亲眼见到真迹时，那种惊叹仍令我猝不及防。
analysis: Even though 让步从句用过去完成时 had admired（“见真迹”之前的经历）| nothing could have prepared me for...：“没有什么能让我预先准备好”——nothing 否定主语 + could have done 对过去的虚拟推定，双重加持“毫无防备”的震撼；此句型是描写“超出预期”的顶级表达 | the wonder (that) I felt：省略关系词定语从句 | lay eyes on 第一次亲眼见到（课堂例句：I loved that book the moment I laid eyes on its cover.；lay-laid-laid 及物，区别 lie-lay-lain）| the real thing 真迹/实物（对照 computer screen）——数字时代看展的共同体验，一句写尽
pattern: Even though + S + had + V-ed ..., nothing could have prepared me for + the N + (that) + S + felt + when ...
imitationCn: 尽管我在视频里看过它无数次，但当我终于站在长城之上时，那种震撼仍令我毫无防备。
imitationHint: Even though I had watched it countless times on video, → nothing could have prepared me for the awe I felt when I finally stood on the Great Wall
imitationAnswer: Even though I had watched it countless times on video, nothing could have prepared me for the awe I felt when I finally stood on the Great Wall.

sentence: It is amazing that every time Monet studied this simple scene, he brought the pond's beauty to the canvas in a unique way.
translation: 令人赞叹的是，莫奈每次端详这处简单的景致，都能以独特的方式把池塘之美带上画布。
analysis: It is amazing that...：it 形式主语 + that 真主语从句（评价先行）| every time 名词短语用作连词引导时间状语从句（= whenever）——课堂同族全表：(the) next time / the first time / the last time + 从句，均可直接当连词用，不加介词 | brought... to the canvas 把……带上画布（bring A to B 的艺术语境）| simple scene vs unique way 对照：景越简单，画法之独越见功力——艺术评论“于平凡见非凡”的经典论证 | 睡莲组画的一句话本质
pattern: It is amazing that + every time + S + V-ed ..., S + brought ... to ... in a unique way
imitationCn: 令人赞叹的是，这位老匠人每次雕同一种花样，都能刻出不一样的神韵。
imitationHint: It is amazing that every time the old craftsman carved the same pattern, → he brought a different spirit to the wood（every time 作连词）
imitationAnswer: It is amazing that every time the old craftsman carved the same pattern, he brought a different spirit to the wood.

sentence: When I saw it up close, I was struck by the small areas of light across the painting, and the way the soft edges of the figures seemed to mix together.
translation: 凑近看时，画面上遍布的细小光斑、人物柔和的轮廓仿佛彼此交融的样子，都令我深受震撼。
analysis: be struck by 被深深打动/震撼（strike 熟词多义课堂全表：击打/突然想到 It struck me that.../罢工/敲钟/划火柴；striking 引人注目的）| the way (that/in which) the soft edges... seemed to mix：课件 the way 定语从句专项——way 后关系词作方式状语时用 that/in which 或省略，不可用 how（That's the way he did it. = That's how he did it.）| up close 近距离地 | 双并列宾语（the small areas of light 和 the way...）挂在同一个 by 之下 | 印象派技法的观感描写：光斑+柔边——看画看的就是这两样
pattern: When + S + saw it up close, S + was struck by + N, and the way + S + seemed to + V
imitationCn: 凑近看时，我被绣品上细密的针脚、丝线在光下仿佛流动的样子深深打动。
imitationHint: When I saw it up close, I was struck by the fine stitches on the embroidery, → and the way the silk threads seemed to flow in the light（the way 后省略关系词）
imitationAnswer: When I saw it up close, I was struck by the fine stitches on the embroidery, and the way the silk threads seemed to flow in the light.

sentence: Although the paintings had very different settings, it was their similarities that stayed with me long after I left the Musée d'Orsay — similarities which can be seen throughout the Impressionists' paintings.
translation: 尽管这些画作背景迥异，但在我离开奥赛博物馆后久久萦绕心头的，却是它们的相似之处——这种相似贯穿于印象派的所有画作。
analysis: 课件结构分析句（三从一强调）| although 让步从句 + it was... that... 强调句凸显主语 their similarities（课堂强调句全套：疑问式 Is it... that...? / What was it that...? / It was not until... that...；判断法：去掉 It was/that 后句子仍完整）| long after I left... 时间从句（long 修饰 after）| 破折号后重复 similarities 再接 which 定语从句——“重复关键词+定从”的滚动推进法，衔接与强调一箭双雕 | stay with sb（记忆/感受）萦绕不去（拟人）
pattern: Although ..., it was + N + that + stayed with me long after ... — N + which ...
imitationCn: 尽管两场演出的风格截然不同，但散场后久久萦绕我心头的却是它们共同的真诚——这种真诚贯穿了每一个谢幕的瞬间。
imitationHint: Although the two performances had very different styles, it was their shared sincerity that stayed with me long after the curtain fell — → sincerity which ran through every moment of the curtain call（强调句+破折号重复）
imitationAnswer: Although the two performances had very different styles, it was their shared sincerity that stayed with me long after the curtain fell — sincerity which ran through every moment of the curtain call.

sentence: Everyday subject matter was the main focus of their works, as opposed to the history paintings that had traditionally dominated European art.
translation: 日常题材是他们作品的主要焦点——这与传统上主宰欧洲艺术的历史画形成鲜明对照。
analysis: as opposed to 与……相对/而非（复合介词表对比，= in contrast to/unlike；课堂例句：200 people attended, as opposed to 300 the previous year.）——艺术史叙事的“新旧对立”一词定调 | that had traditionally dominated：that 定语从句 + 过去完成时（印象派出现“之前”的传统）| dominate 主宰、占主导（课堂多义：占据头条/控制谈话/比赛占优/俯瞰；dominant 占支配地位的）| subject matter 题材（不可数）| 把革命写成对比：画什么（everyday vs history）就是宣言
pattern: S + was the main focus of ..., as opposed to + the N + that had + V-ed ...
imitationCn: 口语交流是这门课的主要焦点——这与传统上主导英语课堂的语法讲解形成对照。
imitationHint: Oral communication is the main focus of this course, → as opposed to the grammar lectures that have traditionally dominated English classes
imitationAnswer: Oral communication is the main focus of this course, as opposed to the grammar lectures that have traditionally dominated English classes.

sentence: They employed free brushwork and used colours to show the effect of light on things, creating paintings that were far less realistic than the works that came before.
translation: 他们运用自由的笔法、以色彩表现光在物体上的效果，画出的作品远不如前人之作写实。
analysis: 并列谓语 employed... and used...（employ 熟词僻义：使用、运用——employ methods/techniques；本义“雇用”：employ sb as）| creating... 现在分词作结果状语（“从而画出……”）| far less realistic than：far 修饰比较级 + less 反向比较——“远不如……写实”不是贬语，恰是印象派的追求，反差修辞 | 双 that 定语从句嵌套：paintings that were... / the works that came before | to show the effect of light on things 目的状语点出技法核心：画光不画物
pattern: S + employed ... and used ... to + V, creating + N + that were far less + adj. + than ...
imitationCn: 她采用极简的布景、用灯光变化来暗示时间流逝，排出的话剧远不如传统版本华丽。
imitationHint: She employed minimal sets and used lighting changes to suggest the passage of time, → creating a play that was far less splendid than the traditional versions（creating 结果状语）
imitationAnswer: She employed minimal sets and used lighting changes to suggest the passage of time, creating a play that was far less splendid than the traditional versions.

sentence: It is also worthy of note that Post-Impressionist painters were not the only ones to be influenced by Impressionism — the movement has had a lasting influence on modern art, encouraging artists to look at the world from an entirely new point of view.
translation: 同样值得注意的是，受印象派影响的并非只有后印象派画家——这场运动对现代艺术产生了持久的影响，鼓励艺术家以全新的视角看世界。
analysis: It is worthy of note that...：it 形式主语 + worthy of note 值得注意（课堂 worth 三兄弟辨析：worth + n./doing、worthy + of n./of being done/to be done、worthwhile + to do/doing）| not the only ones to be influenced：the only 修饰 + 不定式被动后置定语（呼应必修三 U4 的 the first... to receive）| 破折号后转入影响陈述：现在完成时 has had a lasting influence on | encouraging... 现在分词结果状语 + look at... from a... point of view 从……视角看 | 艺术史结论句：影响力的三级跳（后印象派→现代艺术→所有艺术家）
pattern: It is worthy of note that + S + were not the only ones to be + V-ed — S + has had a lasting influence on ..., V-ing ...
imitationCn: 同样值得注意的是，受益的并非只有参赛选手——这项活动对整个校园产生了持久的影响，鼓励更多学生拿起画笔。
imitationHint: It is also worthy of note that the contestants were not the only ones to benefit — → the event has had a lasting influence on the whole campus, encouraging more students to pick up the brush
imitationAnswer: It is also worthy of note that the contestants were not the only ones to benefit — the event has had a lasting influence on the whole campus, encouraging more students to pick up the brush.

sentence: It is commonly believed that the city described in the painting is Bianjing (present-day Kaifeng), the capital of the Northern Song Dynasty.
translation: 人们普遍认为，画中所描绘的城市是汴京（今开封），即北宋的都城。
analysis: 课件结构分析+仿写题 | It is commonly believed that...：it 形式主语 + 被动“据信/人们普遍认为”（同族：It is said/reported/assumed that...——文化介绍的客观化开场）| the city described in the painting：described 过去分词短语作后置定语（= which is described）| 括号 (present-day Kaifeng) 古今地名对照 + 同位语 the capital of... 再补朝代信息——文化名词的“三重注释法”（古名+今名+身份），向外国读者介绍中国文化的标准操作 | 《清明上河图》介绍第一句
pattern: It is commonly believed that + the N + V-ed ... is + 专名 (present-day ...), 同位语
imitationCn: 人们普遍认为，诗中所写的渡口就是瓜洲，即古代长江边的重要码头。
imitationHint: It is commonly believed that the ferry crossing described in the poem is Guazhou, → an important port on the ancient Yangtze（It is believed + 分词定语 + 同位语）
imitationAnswer: It is commonly believed that the ferry crossing described in the poem is Guazhou, an important port on the ancient Yangtze.

sentence: The first section presents a peaceful scene of rural life near Bianjing, featuring crop fields, a river winding through the landscape, and farmers hard at work.
translation: 第一部分展现汴京近郊恬静的乡村生活，重点描绘了农田、蜿蜒而过的河流和辛勤劳作的农民。
analysis: featuring... 现在分词引出三项列举（feature 动词“以……为特色”）——三项各带不同修饰形态：crop fields（裸名词）、a river winding through...（名词+现在分词）、farmers hard at work（名词+形容词短语）——列举的“变奏”避免单调，描写手法的展柜 | wind 熟词僻义：蜿蜒（wind-wound-wound；课堂拓展：wind up 上发条/结束、wind down 放松）| hard at work 辛勤劳作中（形容词短语后置）| present a scene of 展现……的场景 | 长卷描述的标准句式：总（scene）+分（三景）
pattern: S + presents a + adj. + scene of ..., featuring + N, N + V-ing ..., and N + adj.短语
imitationCn: 开篇的镜头展现了小镇清晨的宁静景象，重点呈现了石板街巷、飘着热气的早点摊，和匆匆赶路的行人。
imitationHint: The opening shot presents a peaceful scene of the town's morning, → featuring stone lanes, breakfast stalls steaming with heat, and pedestrians hurrying on their way（三项变奏列举）
imitationAnswer: The opening shot presents a peaceful scene of the town's morning, featuring stone lanes, breakfast stalls steaming with heat, and pedestrians hurrying on their way.

sentence: The second section shows the riverbanks and the central bridge alive with activity as boats sail in and out of Bianjing.
translation: 第二部分描绘熙熙攘攘的河岸与中心桥，往来汴京的船只穿梭其间。
analysis: show + 宾语 + alive with...：alive with 形容词短语作宾语补足语“充满……的生机”（与必修三 U1 的 a sea of green alive with the sounds 跨书呼应——同一个词块两幅名画）| as 引导时间状语从句“随着船只进出” | sail in and out of 驶进驶出（方向副词对举）| the riverbanks and the central bridge 双宾语并列——虹桥正是全卷最热闹的“C位” | 动静相生的画面句：桥是静的，activity 和 boats 让它活起来
pattern: S + shows + N + alive with activity + as + S + sail in and out of ...
imitationCn: 第二幕呈现出充满烟火气的老街，人力车在巷口进进出出。
imitationHint: The second act shows the old street alive with everyday bustle → as rickshaws move in and out of the lanes（alive with 作宾补）
imitationAnswer: The second act shows the old street alive with everyday bustle as rickshaws move in and out of the lanes.

sentence: Here, hundreds of people from all walks of life, including butchers, hairdressers and government officials, can be seen going about their daily business.
translation: 在这里，可以看到数以百计各行各业的人——肉贩、理发匠、官员——都在忙着各自的营生。
analysis: from all walks of life 各行各业（walk 熟词僻义“行业、阶层”——固定短语）| including... 插入举例三职业：屠夫/理发匠/官员——从市井到官府的社会切片 | can be seen going about...：被动感官结构 see sb doing 的被动式（= we can see them going...），观画视角的客观化 | go about one's daily business 忙自己的日常营生（go about 着手/忙于）| Here 开头把读者拉到画前 | 《清明上河图》的社会学价值一句话：全阶层入画
pattern: Here, hundreds of + N + from all walks of life, including ..., can be seen + V-ing ...
imitationCn: 在庙会上，可以看到各行各业的上千市民——手艺人、小贩、学生——都在享受各自的乐趣。
imitationHint: At the temple fair, thousands of citizens from all walks of life, including craftsmen, vendors and students, → can be seen enjoying themselves in their own ways
imitationAnswer: At the temple fair, thousands of citizens from all walks of life, including craftsmen, vendors and students, can be seen enjoying themselves in their own ways.

sentence: The combination of these three sections gives the viewer an idea of what life was like for the people of Bianjing.
translation: 三部分合观，便能让观者大致了解当年汴京百姓的生活样貌。
analysis: 课件仿写题 | The combination of... 抽象名词作主语：“三部分的组合”自己“给出”认识——物称主语的客观笔调 | give sb an idea of 让某人大致了解 | what life was like for sb：what 引导宾语从句作 of 的宾语（介词后接 what 从句），what... like 结构“……是什么样子”——课堂仿写：Can you give me an idea of how big the art exhibition is? | 总结句式：分述完三段后一句收拢——说明文“分总”的合页
pattern: The combination of + N + gives sb an idea of + what + S + was like for ...
imitationCn: 这三组老照片合在一起，能让读者大致了解上世纪八十年代小城生活的模样。
imitationHint: The combination of these three groups of old photos gives the reader an idea of → what life was like in the small town in the 1980s（what...like 从句作 of 宾语）
imitationAnswer: The combination of these three groups of old photos gives the reader an idea of what life was like in the small town in the 1980s.

sentence: Using ink on silk, he creates realistic images of scenery, buildings and people, and displays a remarkable mastery of perspective.
translation: 他施墨于绢，笔下风景、建筑、人物无不逼真传神，同时展现出对透视法的非凡驾驭。
analysis: 课件结构分析+仿写题 | Using ink on silk：现在分词短语作方式状语（“用绢上施墨的方式”）| and 连接两个并列谓语 creates... and displays...——一笔两得：画得真（images）+ 画得高（mastery）| a remarkable mastery of perspective 对透视法的精通（mastery of 对……的掌握；perspective 透视法/视角）| scenery, buildings and people 三宾语并列 | 历史现在时让千年前的画家“正在作画” | 艺术技法评价的标准句：材料（ink on silk）+成果（images）+功力（mastery）
pattern: Using + N, S + creates + N + of A, B and C, and displays a + adj. + mastery of + N
imitationCn: 借助老师推荐的学习方法，杰克稳步提高了成绩，也展现出对时间管理的出色掌控。
imitationHint: Using the method recommended by the teacher, Jack has steadily improved his grades, → and displays a remarkable mastery of time management（课堂仿写延展）
imitationAnswer: Using the method recommended by the teacher, Jack has steadily improved his grades, and displays a remarkable mastery of time management.
